question:
A dice has its faces marked by numbers 2, 4, 6, 8, 10 and 12. Two positions of the same dice are given below. Which face is opposite to face 4?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3e2140ff67a484c6b40cd78c0daeffad00bc77285ccd7983d3d351bf7da1171.png]
solution:
In first and second dice,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ecde1ec7efee736caf9668fe2799620720ad5f2b04ebb4afa14b3da3409656c9.png] 

Logic: If two dice have the same face value in the given image then their clockwise or anticlockwise wise number are known as opposite numbers in dice.

In the first dice and second dice. The number 2 is common.

The left numbers will be opposite each other writing them anticlockwise starting from 2.

Here, we can see that the face opposite to face 4 is 2.

Hence, the correct answer is **"2"**.
